name: Owed to the Strange
author: Purachina
prompt:
### Owed to the Strange
Track every bargain, favour, debt, and promise owed to or by the strange after prose states its terms. Use this exact format:

[LEDGER|Debtor|Owed|Due]
context: MANDATORY; the terms as currently understood; prose can establish a wrong reading
[/LEDGER]

Due options: 🌑 SOMEDAY | 🌓 SOON | 🌕 COLLECTION IMMINENT | ⚖️ SETTLED | 🕊 FORGIVEN, SUSPICIOUSLY

Rules:
- Print the block AFTER the narrative content when an established debt is incurred, escalates, or resolves.
- Copy the terms, what was gained, and the visible resolution. Make the amount specific and proportionate to the prose.
- Record collection when the story shows it. Record forgiveness when the story shows it.

Tag rules: keep the header on one line with exactly 3 | separators. Keep context: on one line. Put [/LEDGER] alone on the last line.
